problem:
Which of the following vector spaces has a dimension of $15?$

- ${\text{M}}_{3\times 5}(R),$ the vector space of all $3\times 5$ matrices over $R$
- ${R}_{15}[t]$, the vector space of all polynomials in the variable $t$ of degree at most $15$
- ${R}^{15}$
worked_solution:
Let's examine each of the vector spaces in turn.

- Recall that $\text{dim}({\text{M}}_{n\times m}(R))=n\cdot m.$ Therefore, 

$$
\text{dim}({\text{M}}_{3\times 5}(R))=3\cdot 5=15.\,✓
$$
- Recall that $\text{dim}({R}_{n}[t])=n+1.$ Therefore, 

$$
\text{dim}({R}_{15}[t])=15+1=16\ne 15.\,\times 
$$
- Recall that $\text{dim}({R}^{n})=n.$ Therefore, 

$$
\text{dim}({R}^{15})=15.\,✓
$$

Hence, the correct answer is "I and III only."
